_comment: Try it before you choose. Each entry is listed only where the provider's own page says school students can take part, quoted verbatim and string-matched by code on checkedOn. who/when/cost/how/status are our plain-English summaries of those quotes. Topics are our judgement. Real internships for under-18s are rare; these are the forms that exist.

kinds.label: Paid work as part of the HSC

opportunities.name: NYSF Year 12 Program
opportunities.where: Canberra or Brisbane (live on a university campus)
opportunities.who: Apply during Year 11; the program is in the January before Year 12.
opportunities.cost: Program fee plus a $70 application fee. Scholarships and Rotary support exist.
opportunities.status: The January 2027 program is closed. It is only for students about to start Year 12.

quotes.text: In 2027 the program runs in Canberra (6–14 January) and Brisbane (13–21 January).
The 2027 program fee is $3,180, invoiced on acceptance and due October 2026.
Applications for the 2027 NYSF Year 12 Program are now closed.
Open to students in Year 11 about to start Year 12, from every background and every part of Australia.

opportunities.name: Work experience at Mount Stromlo Observatory
opportunities.when: One week, on school days during term — not in the holidays.

quotes.text: The Mount Stromlo Observatory offers a limited number of work experience places to year 10, 11 and 12 students each year.
Availability: Weekdays during teaching periods.
Cost: No cost

opportunities.name: What's My Discipline?
opportunities.when: One day. The 2026 Sydney event was in October.
opportunities.how: Register on the BAE Systems page.

quotes.text: What's My Discipline? Years 11 and 12
9 October 2026 – 175 Liverpool Street, Sydney NSW

opportunities.name: Nuclear NextGen
opportunities.provider: ANSTO (Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organisation)
opportunities.where: Lucas Heights, Sydney (some days at the Australian Synchrotron, Melbourne)
opportunities.who: Years 9–12. Places offered on merit, up to 20 a session.
opportunities.when: One-day sessions in the school holidays, 10am–3pm. Each day has a different topic.
opportunities.how: Apply online; rank the days you want.
opportunities.status: In 2026, Sydney applications closed on 1 March.

quotes.text: ANSTO’s Nuclear NextGen program offers high school students in Years 9–12 a unique opportunity to explore exciting STEM careers and discover how nuclear science impacts everyday life.
Nuclear NextGen programs will each run for one day in the school holidays from 10am to 3pm.
Applications for all Lucas Heights (Sydney) programs will close on the 1st of March, with successful applicants notified by the 23rd of March.

opportunities.name: Stem Cell Academy
opportunities.who: Years 10–12, especially students in Western Sydney. No experience needed.
opportunities.how: Apply through the CMRI page; dates are agreed with your school.

quotes.text: This one-week hands-on program from 23-27 November 2026, gives Year 10, 11 and 12 High School students, especially in Western Sydney, a unique opportunity to do real science in a real lab—no experience necessary!
Applications are now closed.

opportunities.name: Work experience at the Australian Museum
opportunities.when: Five days (Monday to Friday) in Term 3 or 4.
opportunities.how: Apply through the museum; a panel chooses.
opportunities.status: 2026 applications are closed. In 2026 offers came in late May.

quotes.text: The program is available for students in Years 10–12 and will be offered during Terms 3 and 4, over four possible weeks:
Each placement is limited to 5 days (Monday to Friday) working 10am–4pm each day.
The application period for the 2026 work experience program is now closed.

opportunities.name: Computer Science High School Fellowship (INFO1110)
opportunities.provider: University of Sydney, School of Computer Science
opportunities.where: Mostly online, with 2–3 workshops at the University of Sydney
opportunities.who: Years 10–12 at selected schools, recommended by the careers adviser.
opportunities.when: The two university pages disagree: the program site says August to November (2025); the faculty page says December–January.
opportunities.how: Only through your school careers adviser.
opportunities.status: Ask your careers adviser whether your school takes part.

quotes.text: Students in Years 10–12 with a strong interest in computer science or programming.
Applications are accepted only from selected schools via recommendations from the school’s career advisors.
The program is free of charge, thanks to the support of the University of Sydney.
The program is run in an intensive program across December-January.

opportunities.name: Project Management Spring Camp
opportunities.provider: University of Sydney, School of Project Management
opportunities.where: University of Sydney, with an industry site visit
opportunities.when: One day in the October school holidays.
opportunities.how: Register on the University of Sydney page.

quotes.text: The University of Sydney School of Project Management runs the annual in-person Spring Camp during the October school holidays for high school students in Years 10-12.

opportunities.name: Australian Informatics Olympiad
opportunities.who: Senior division: students up to Year 12.
opportunities.when: One 3-hour paper. 2027: Thursday 26 August (entries close Friday 20 August).

quotes.text: Senior – students up to Australian Year 12
Entries close: Friday 20 August 2027
COST AUD $25.90 per student
DATE Thursday 26 August 2027

opportunities.name: AWS Educate
opportunities.who: Anyone 13 or older, with an email address.

quotes.text: Learners as young as 13 can register for AWS Educate with just an email address, gaining access to free hands-on labs to learn and practice cloud skills in real-time.

opportunities.name: School work experience
opportunities.who: Students at NSW schools, through the school.
opportunities.when: Usually a week; your school sets the dates.
opportunities.how: Ask your school careers adviser. The school arranges it, which keeps it safe and insured.
opportunities.status: The route to any lab or company that does not run its own program.

quotes.text: Work experience provides a general introduction to the world of work.
Students are not paid for workplace learning.

opportunities.name: School-based apprenticeship or traineeship
opportunities.who: Years 10–12 at NSW schools doing the HSC.
opportunities.when: Runs through the school year, as part of your HSC.
opportunities.how: Ask your school. It changes your HSC pattern, so ask how it affects your ATAR first.

quotes.text: SBATs are available to all Year 10, 11 and 12 high school students in NSW undertaking the Higher School Certificate (HSC).
A school-based apprenticeship or traineeship combines paid work, training and school.
Some apprenticeships and traineeships contribute towards the ATAR.

opportunities.name: PECAN+ Capture the Flag
opportunities.provider: Edith Cowan University, hosted in NSW by the University of Wollongong
opportunities.where: Wollongong campus, University of Wollongong (the 2026 NSW event)
opportunities.who: Years 10–12. Teams of up to 4; enter alone and you are put in a team on the day.
opportunities.when: Two days in August: a training day, then the competition. 2026: 22–23 August.
opportunities.how: Register on the UOW event page. The 2026 event filled up and now has a waitlist.
opportunities.status: The 2026 event is full. Watch for 2027 from mid-year.

quotes.text: invite Australian high school students in years 10-12 to compete in PECAN+ Capture The Flag 2026!
Dates: Saturday 22 August 2026 (Training Day) and Sunday 23 August 2026 (Competition Day)
Cost: FREE!
Compete in teams of up to 4 students.
Registrations for this event have now closed.

opportunities.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
opportunities.who: Students at a high school, college or university, aged 13 or over.
opportunities.when: Any time. Good for building a portfolio of your own coding projects.
opportunities.cost: Free. Includes GitHub Pro while you are a student.
opportunities.how: Apply online yourself with proof that you are a student, such as a school ID.

quotes.text: Are enrolled in a degree- or diploma-granting program, such as a high school, college, university, or homeschool.
Are at least 13 years old.
Free GitHub Pro while you are a student.
